root_cause: The harness constructed a cmd.exe command string with escaped quote characters as literal input. cmd.exe therefore rejected the quoted bootstrap-vcpkg.bat string before the batch file executed. This is a harness invocation defect, not a vcpkg, baseline, compiler, build or test failure.

failed_command.name: vcpkg-bootstrap
failed_command.stderr_summary: The escaped quoted bootstrap-vcpkg.bat command was not recognized as an internal or external command, operable program, or batch file.

evidence_storage_note: The full local evidence package is preserved on the maintainer physical Windows PC. The repository .gitignore excludes /docs for untracked local evidence, so this record binds the failed local package by exact run identity and SHA-256 manifest hash without reclassifying it as PASS.
